allOf.description: This campaign's own contact frequency cap. It can only make the team cap stricter. Contact frequency caps are a beta; a team that is not enrolled gets `403 feature_unavailable`. Omit, or send null, to use the team cap alone.

Replaces this campaign's own contact frequency cap; null removes it and leaves the team cap. Only a draft or paused campaign can change it. Setting a cap requires the contact frequency caps beta; removing one does not.

CampaignRecipient.failureReason.description: Why the recipient was not sent, or why its last attempt did not succeed. Null when nothing went wrong. `opted_out`: the number is on the team's opt-out list. `cold_held`: the number never wrote to the sending number and the campaign holds cold sends. `campaign_cancelled`: the campaign was stopped before this recipient was sent. `invalid_recipient`: the number is not a valid WhatsApp address. `session_not_connected`: the sending number was not connected. `ack_timeout`: WhatsApp did not acknowledge the send in time. `blocked_by_safety`: a safety check refused the send before it was attempted; the recipient waits for the campaign to resume. `send_failed`: WhatsApp refused the send, or its outcome could not be confirmed. `missing_variable`: the campaign was launched with `skipMissingVariables` and the recipient had no value and no fallback for a variable. `frequency_cap`: the recipient reached the team's or campaign's rolling contact frequency cap. `other`: any other reason. New codes may be added.

**Required scope:** `campaigns:manage`

Adds up to 1,000 recipients to a campaign that has not started sending. A phone already on the campaign is skipped. Invalid entries are reported and not added.

parameters.description: Optional key, 1 to 255 bytes of UTF-8, that makes this request safe to retry for 24 hours. A retry with the same key, credential, `Polymorfa-Version` and request is not applied again: it returns `200` with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and the replay result described for this operation. Reusing the key for a different request returns `409 idempotency_conflict`. A retry sent while the original is still running waits for it and then returns its result. A request that failed left no record, so retrying it with the same key runs it again. Access to the resource is checked again on every retry. A replay returns the original counts, even after the campaign has launched.

get.description:
Returns the team's contact frequency cap: the most campaign messages one phone number receives from the team in any rolling 24 hours and any rolling 7 days. Every campaign message counts, first messages and later messages of a sequence, from every campaign, project and number in the team. Test sends and messages sent outside campaigns do not count. `null` means no limit for that window. A team that never saved a cap receives both limits `null` and `revision` 0. A campaign can set its own, stricter cap with `frequencyCap`. Accepts a team API key or a live signed-in team member.

API keys require `campaigns:read`. Project tokens are not accepted.

X-Trace-Id.description: W3C trace ID of this request. Your `traceparent` trace ID when you sent a valid one.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

put.description:
Replaces the team's contact frequency cap using the `revision` you read; a changed revision answers `409`. Send `null` for a window to remove its limit, or both `null` to remove the cap. Setting a limit requires the contact frequency caps beta and otherwise answers `403 feature_unavailable`; removing the cap does not. Requires a team API key or a signed-in team owner or admin; project tokens answer `403`. A message over the cap is skipped with `frequency_cap_exceeded`; a later sequence message stops that recipient's remaining sequence. Settled skips are never retried when a cap changes.

API keys require `campaigns:manage`. Project tokens are not accepted.

X-Trace-Id.description: W3C trace ID of this request. Your `traceparent` trace ID when you sent a valid one.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.
